title: The Second Cup of Warm Milk
youtube_title: The Second Cup of Warm Milk | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Making room at the table is a kind of abundance.
summary: At a ferry bench with a folded blanket, Yelena sees that a second cup of warm milk will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Yelena makes a smaller, even share so Cosima is included, and Miss Dalca lets the choice stand without a speech.
